svg.title: LEONARD E. MOORE — latest RSS headlines

g.text: YouTube streaming data returns to Billboard charts, ending major disagreement ◆ Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns ◆ AI hardware startup Nominal triples valuation to $3B in 8 months ◆ France blames Iran for mass-hacks targeting freezers in grocery stores and blood banks ◆ Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy puts Nvidia’s China ambitions under scrutiny ◆ Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution ◆
